order is created already `confirmed`: the waiter placing it does not
need to approve their own order.

get.summary: Get the public menu for a table QR public token
get.description:
Return the full public menu for a table's public token, ready for
rendering: categories, products, prices and modifiers, filtered to
what is publicly visible and translated to the resolved locale.

404.description: Table not found, or menu not available

post.summary: Create an order from the public QR surface
post.description:
Create an order from the public QR surface. Requires an active table
session (unlike the menu, which is servable without one). The
frontend only sends intent (which RestaurantProduct, quantity,
modifier selections, notes) — price/totals/status/origin are always
computed/assigned by the backend.

200.description: Idempotent replay of a previously created order

404.description: Table not found or not publicly servable

409.description: No active table session, a concurrent session close, or a reused idempotency key

422.description: Invalid item/modifier selection or malformed request

get.summary: Resolve a table QR public token
get.description:
Resolve a table's public token: which restaurant/table it points to,
whether it has an active session, and whether a menu is available.
Does not return the menu content itself.

404.description: Table not found or not publicly servable
